title: spec liveness ledger drift: `field.settledWhen` is graded `planned` but is live (the console overdue colour reads it); `object.tenancy` has no ledger row
body:
Filing gate: ① product defect, reproduced, landing site named.
Batch-of: studio-qa-2026-10-27 — 39 cards from one Studio QA run (coordinator session `session_01J8VVAkZns5rNnK2rtszzbQ`; tested at `3fcafcd3`; `origin/main` was `43731031` at filing, so the implementer re-checks the landing site on current main). The run record is the `qa-run` issue filed with this batch.

## Symptom

The ledger is what tells authors and agents whether a key does anything; two rows disagree with the measured runtime.

## Reproduction

1. A date field with `dueLike` and a `settledWhen` predicate: the predicate controls whether the overdue colour is shown in the console (measured by the data gap-fill card). The ledger row says `planned`.
2. `packages/spec/liveness/object.json` has no `tenancy` row although `tenancy: {enabled:false}` removes the `organization_id` column.

## Expected

`settledWhen` graded live with its consumer named; `tenancy` given a row.

## Suspected landing site (the implementer verifies)

`packages/spec/liveness/field.json`, `packages/spec/liveness/object.json`.

## Filing facts

- reach: Console UI + ledger read, measured by the data gap-fill card.
- Business reason: A planned verdict on a live key makes agents treat it as inert.
- Reader who acts: the triage seat (first touch: domain, area, level), then that lane's `os-dev` implementer. QA suggestion only: `domain:spec`, `area:devpath`, p3.
- Dedupe: semantic search `liveness ledger settledWhen graded planned but live, tenancy has no ledger row` on objectstack-ai/objectstack → 16 hits, none for these two rows (nearest closed #26146, #16362).
- QA id: L1
